episodes.title: Dostoevskij
episodes.summary: Investigator Enzo Vitello, a man and father with a dark past, investigates Dostoevsky, a killer who always leaves a letter with his vision of the world next to his victims.

episodes.title: La città dei figli sbagliati
episodes.summary: Vitello secretly exchanges messages with the killer, while trying to deal with the drug problems of his daughter, Ambra, abandoned years before.

episodes.title: Il contenitore
episodes.summary: Vitello follows the clue in the last letter and explores the trail of former orphans. When the letters are released to the press, Vitello is betrayed and his investigation compromised.

episodes.title: Porte
episodes.summary: Vitello discovers who Dostoevsky is, a victim of the orphanage under a dark influence, and confesses to his daughter the reason for his departure years ago.

episodes.title: Mai vista stagione peggiore
episodes.summary: Vitello tracks down Esposito, Dostoevsky's weapons supplier, and forces him to ask the killer to reach them, to arrive at the final face to face.

episodes.title: Non siate crudeli con un finale
episodes.summary: Finale. Vitello and Dostoevsky, the moment of reckoning, two human beings united but distant, arrived to fight against their destiny.
